requirements.description: Every score response must lead with the maturity rung label (R0–R4) computed by invoking the shared maturity-go ladder gate predicates. The rung must be derived from per-dimension error and open counts decoded from cached phase-results findings (proto ArchitectureFinding decode with EM-format fallback). The headline must be labeled 'as of digest td:…' using the digest stamped on the recorded runs, and must never be presented as ecosystem-manager's live state. No local copy of the maturity ladder logic is permitted — only packages/maturity-go must be used.
requirements.title: Maturity Rung Headline Derived from Cached Phase Results via Shared Ladder Gates
